mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong consumer demand in the housing market, which spills over into broader economic growth and positively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative when HOUST is above its historical average, occurring in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when UNRATE is below 4%, occurring in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates tight monetary policy, leading to decreased borrowing and investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS is above 0.1, occurring in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth (GDPC1) is strong and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is moderate, it creates a Goldilocks economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when GDPC1 growth is strong and CPIAUCSL is moderate, occurring in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a robust labor market, leading to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when PAYEMS is above its historical average, occurring in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is low and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is high, it indicates a potential monetary policy mismatch, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are positive when UNRATE is low and FEDFUNDS is high, occurring in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when RSAFS is above its historical average, occurring in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth (INDPRO) indicates strong supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Forward returns are negative when INDPRO is above its historical average, occurring in more than 40% of cases.
